import os,sys,signal,time,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/data/data/com.termux/files/home/OptimusAI_V41_LIVE')
subprocess.run(['git','fetch','origin','main'],cwd=root,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','reset','--hard','origin/main'],cwd=root,check=True)
script=str(root/'scripts'/'project_finisher_agent.py')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','py_compile',script],cwd=root,check=True)
old=[]
for name in os.listdir('/proc'):
 if not name.isdigit(): continue
 pid=int(name)
 if pid==os.getpid(): continue
 try:
  cmdline=Path('/proc',name,'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\x00',b' ').decode(errors='ignore')
  if script in cmdline and '--worker' in cmdline:
   os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM); old.append(pid)
 except (OSError,ProcessLookupError): pass
time.sleep(2)
env=os.environ.copy(); env['FINISHER_DAEMON_CHILD']='1'
log=open(root/'output'/'project_finisher_agent.log','a',encoding='utf-8')
p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,script,'--worker'],cwd=root,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=log,start_new_session=True,env=env,close_fds=True)
time.sleep(2)
try: os.kill(p.pid,0); alive=True
except OSError: alive=False
print('HEAD='+subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip())
print('OLD_WORKERS_TERMINATED='+str(old))
print('NEW_WORKER_PID='+str(p.pid))
print('NEW_WORKER_ALIVE='+str(alive))
print('PID_FILE='+((root/'output'/'project_finisher_agent.pid').read_text().strip() if (root/'output'/'project_finisher_agent.pid').exists() else 'MISSING'))
